identified_issues: Breaker BKR_512 was physically tripped for planned maintenance without an approved, pre-authorized Switching Order registered in DISPATCH_EMS prior to execution, violating Regional Grid Operating Standard Section 4.2.1.

Retrospective switching order SO-2026-8812 was submitted post-actuation (2 minutes 13 seconds after breaker trip) and designated RETROSPECTIVE_UNAUTHORIZED, which cannot cure an unauthorized physical disconnection under Section 4.2.3.

The compliance auditor introduced an epistemic conflation between pre-authorization requirements (Section 4.2.1) and completion logging timelines (Section 4.2.2, which allows 15 minutes for post-execution reporting); however, the substantive compliance failure remains definitively established by the absence of prior authorization.
evidence: DISPATCH_EMS registry at 2026-10-06T15:45:00.000Z and 15:50:00.000Z confirms 'No switching order on file for BKR_512' and 'Pre-authorization status: NONE'.
RELAY_SEL_451 digital fault recorder log confirms physical manual trip pushbutton depression at 2026-10-06T16:10:02.100Z and BKR_512 contact status change to OPEN at 16:10:02.145Z.

DISPATCH_EMS entry EMS_LOG_9941 at 2026-10-06T16:12:15.000Z confirms retrospective ticket submission with 'Reference Order: NONE (unapproved retrospective request SO-2026-8812 created 2m 13s post-switching)' and 'Status: RETROSPECTIVE_UNAUTHORIZED'.
recommended_action: Sustain the FAIL verdict against the switching operation for non-compliance with Regional Grid Operating Standard Section 4.2.1 and 4.2.3. Issue an operational non-conformance notice for manual switching without prior EMS authorization, enforce electrical interlock or supervisory dispatch release controls on SEL-451 manual trip inputs for planned maintenance, and clarify compliance audit documentation to evaluate prior authorization state rather than conflating it with the 15-minute post-execution completion logging window.
